title: Final Probability P1
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the probability P1 for one O₂ adsorbed as P1 = 4x/(1+x)^4.

title: Final Probability P4
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the probability P4 for four O₂ adsorbed as P4 = (x/(1+x))^4.

title: Correct Variable Definition
description: Important Criteria: The student must define the variable x = λe^(-ε/τ) correctly in the context of the problem.

title: Gibbs Partition Function
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the use of the Gibbs partition function and its significance in the derivation.

title: Qualitative Sketch
description: Optional Criteria: The student should provide a qualitative sketch of the probabilities as functions of x, indicating the trends.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as incorrect application of the partition function or miscalculating probabilities.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all terms are dimensionally consistent, particularly in the context of energy and activity.
